Description : RESPOND is a Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD) application built to reduce crime
 and enable rapid response across the city. When a citizen calls 112 (police emergency number),
 the call is registered as an event in the system. This event is then dispatched by a controller,
 who assigns a First Responder (vehicle) to the location for immediate action including call volumes and response status.
